title: The truncated oath
narrative: Fangore’s agent must not quietly drop mandatory blockers just because the prompt budget is tight. He runs the context compiler with a tiny token budget and a mandatory policy oath that cannot fit. Success is a deficit report — unresolved gaps named, blockers preserved — not a silently shortened prompt that looks complete. Deterministic steps can skip a model prompt entirely. He relates to this whenever working context is an ephemeral view, never the only copy of obligations.
